name: Casita Robada
description: Casita Robada (Stolen House) is a children's fishing game popular in Argentina. Also known as Steal the Old Man's Bundle or Rubamazzo in Italy. Players capture cards by matching ranks and can steal opponents' entire bundles by matching the top card.

overview.description: Casita Robada (Stolen House) is a children's fishing game popular in Argentina. Also known as Steal the Old Man's Bundle or Rubamazzo in Italy. Players capture cards by matching ranks and can steal opponents' entire bundles by matching the top card.

history.origins: Casita Robada is the Argentinean name for this children's fishing game. It's also known as Steal the Old Man's Bundle, Steal the Old Man's Pack, or Steal Pile in English-speaking countries. In Italy it's called Rubamazzo. The game is popular among children for its simple rules and exciting 'stealing' mechanic.
timeline: Traditional: Played for generations in Argentina and Italy
Modern: Known worldwide under various names
history.cultural: Popular children's game in Argentina (Casita Robada) and Italy (Rubamazzo). The 'stealing' aspect makes it exciting for children learning card games.
history.evolution: The game has remained largely unchanged. The core mechanic of stealing bundles by matching the top card is consistent across all variants.

setup.deck: Standard 52-card pack. Suits are irrelevant - only ranks matter.
setup.dealing: Highest card draws to deal first. Dealer gives 4 cards face down to each player and 4 face up to the center (layout). Remaining deck held by dealer for subsequent deals.

rules.objective: Collect the most cards by capturing from the layout and stealing opponents' bundles.
rules.gameplay: Player to dealer's left starts, clockwise. Must play one card from hand face up. If played card matches rank of any face-up center card, capture the played card and all matched cards, adding to your face-up bundle pile with played card on top. If played card matches top card of opponent's bundle, steal their entire bundle and add to yours with your played card on top. After all players play their 4 cards, dealer deals 4 more cards each (no more to layout). Continue until all cards played. Player who made last capture takes any remaining layout cards.
keyRules: Only card ranks matter, suits ignored
4 cards dealt to each player, 4 to layout
Must play one card per turn
Match opponent's top bundle card to steal entire bundle
Played card always goes on top of your pile

strategy.basic: Play matching cards when you have them. Try to steal big bundles from opponents.
strategy.intermediate: Remember what ranks are on top of opponent bundles. Try to protect your own bundle by not leaving valuable top cards.
strategy.advanced: Card counting to track which ranks remain. Timing when to steal vs building your own bundle. Endgame awareness for last capture.
tips: Watch opponents' top cards for stealing opportunities
Try to keep your bundle's top card hard to match
Stealing a big bundle is better than small captures
Remember which ranks have been played
Last capture of the game gets all remaining layout cards
